elements.label: Floating wall of rounded game-clip cards on a pale gradient, pulling back then drifting in depth

sfx_review.label: swoosh_reverse
sfx_review.note: Broadband swell at the start of the pull-back as the Venice clip shrinks into the card wall.

sfx_review.label: whoosh
sfx_review.note: Sharp onset then decay (not a build-up) as the headline settles from large/blurred to final size; reads as a forward whoosh. Low certainty.

pattern.description: The full-screen gameplay clip shrinks back into a floating wall of many rounded clip cards at varied depths with depth-of-field blur; cards drift and parallax while a two-line white headline flies in from oversized and blurred, scaling down to rest centred over the wall.
pattern.why_premium: Turns 'library of content' into a literal spatial wall: depth blur, varied card sizes and continuous drift give a 3D, volumetric feel, and the headline's scale-down-with-blur landing reads as the camera focusing on the message.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.wall',{scale:2.2},{scale:1,duration:0.9,ease:'power3.inOut'}).fromTo('.card',{opacity:0,z:-400},{opacity:1,z:0,stagger:{each:0.03,from:'random'},duration:0.6,ease:'power2.out'},0).fromTo('.headline .line',{scale:1.8,filter:'blur(14px)',opacity:0},{scale:1,filter:'blur(0px)',opacity:1,duration:0.35,stagger:0.04,ease:'expo.out'},0.6); cards keep a slow yoyo drift; far cards get filter blur for depth.
build_hint.remotion: Wall container scale interpolate(frame,[0,27],[2.2,1],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); per-card opacity/translateZ with frame offsets from a seeded random stagger; headline lines spring({frame:frame-18,fps,config:{damping:200,stiffness:120}}) driving scale 1.8->1 and blur 14->0 (no overshoot).

notes: camera.move is none; scale 0.80 reflects the card wall content shrinking, not a camera move. b01 changed_share 0.78 covers the whole wall; individual cards beyond b04-b06 have no boxes. x028 override is uncertain.
